patentability_framework.statement: There is no single 'international patent'. Patentability is decided by each national/regional patent office. International instruments set minimum standards and shared procedures but do not themselves grant patents. Actual requirements depend on the target country/region.

traditional_knowledge_relevance.statement: Traditional knowledge is treated as prior art that can destroy novelty in most jurisdictions, but there is no universal statutory bar equivalent to India's Section 3(p). Treatment varies by country.
traditional_knowledge_relevance.citation: Not verified for any specific country; general international position

prior_art_treatment.statement: Documented traditional knowledge (including TKDL, where access has been granted to a patent office) can act as defeating prior art for novelty and non-obviousness. Whether a given office consults TKDL depends on bilateral access arrangements.
prior_art_treatment.citation: WIPO – traditional knowledge and prior art

disclosure_requirements.statement: Source / origin disclosure of genetic resources is being harmonised. The WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (2024) introduces a disclosure requirement for participating members; applicability depends on ratification and the target office.
disclosure_requirements.citation: WIPO GRATK Treaty, 2024 (applicability depends on member state)

biodiversity_ABS_relevance.statement: Access-and-benefit-sharing obligations depend on whether the relevant country is a party to the Convention on Biological Diversity and the Nagoya Protocol, and on that country's implementing law.
biodiversity_ABS_relevance.citation: Convention on Biological Diversity; Nagoya Protocol (party-dependent)

formulation_related_considerations.statement: Whether a herbal / traditional formulation is patentable varies by jurisdiction. Some offices are more permissive absent a Section 3(p)-style bar, but documented prior art (including TK) can still defeat novelty. Country-specific rules cannot be stated without selecting a target country.
formulation_related_considerations.citation: Not verified for any specific country

source_requirements.statement: Source-disclosure and ABS-compliance requirements differ by country; some require declaration of origin, others do not. Confirm against the target office's rules.
source_requirements.citation: Not verified for any specific country

limitations: International comparison provides a general international framework. Actual patentability and legal requirements depend on the target country/region.
No country-specific rule is asserted unless a target country has been explicitly selected and authoritative data exists.
No international ML risk score exists in the current model; only the India-side deterministic assessment carries a concern level.
